# RDS MySQL Upgrade Assistant

> Automates batch Blue/Green deployment upgrades for Amazon RDS MySQL to 8.4.

## Overview

This is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that provides 17 tools for automating RDS MySQL upgrades. Any AI tool that supports MCP can use this server.

## MCP Server

- Transport: stdio
- Command: `uv run --directory /path/to/rds-mysql-upgrade-assistant python -m rds_upgrade_mcp.server`

## Available Tools

- `discover_instances` — Find all RDS MySQL instances by version and tags
- `run_precheck` — Run 19 SQL compatibility checks (MySQL 8.0→8.4)
- `batch_precheck` — Run prechecks across all instances in a region
- `batch_status` — Check progress of a previous batch upgrade run
- `batch_upgrade` — Execute batch upgrade with concurrency and resume support
- `generate_config` — Auto-generate batch config from discovered instances
- `migrate_params` — Migrate parameter group to target engine family
- `prepare_param_group` — Auto-detect and prepare parameter group for upgrade
- `check_option_group` — Check and migrate custom option groups
- `create_blue_green` — Create Blue/Green deployment for MySQL upgrade
- `monitor_blue_green` — Poll deployment status until ready
- `pre_switchover_check` — Verify switchover guardrails before proceeding
- `switchover` — Execute Blue/Green switchover
- `upgrade_green_instance` — Upgrade green instance in two-step B/G
- `in_place_upgrade` — Run in-place upgrade for instances/clusters
- `validate_upgrade` — Post-upgrade infrastructure validation
- `app_validate` — Run application-level SQL validation
- `cleanup_blue_green` — Delete Blue/Green deployment after switchover

## Upgrade Workflow

1. Discover MySQL 8.0 instances
2. Run precheck (19 SQL compatibility checks)
3. Migrate parameter group and option group
4. Create Blue/Green deployment (or in-place upgrade)
5. Monitor until green is ready
6. Validate green environment
7. Pre-switchover check
8. Switchover
9. Post-upgrade validation
10. Cleanup old environment

## Supported Upgrade Paths

| Source | Target | Method |
|--------|--------|--------|
| MySQL 8.0.28+ | 8.4.9 | Blue/Green or in-place |
| MySQL 8.0 + custom option group | 8.4.9 | Two-step Blue/Green |
| MySQL 5.7 | 8.4.9 | Multi-hop Blue/Green |
| Multi-AZ DB Cluster (8.0) | 8.4.9 | In-place only |

## Prerequisites

- AWS CLI v2 with appropriate IAM permissions
- mysql client (standard MySQL command-line client)
- jq (JSON processor)
- Python 3.10+ with uv (for MCP server)

## Configuration

Set environment variables:
- `AWS_PROFILE` — AWS CLI profile to use
- `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` — Target AWS region

## Example Prompts

- "Discover all MySQL 8.0 instances in us-west-2"
- "Run precheck on prod-db-01 using secret prod/db01/creds"
- "Create a Blue/Green deployment for prod-db-01 upgrading to 8.4.9"
- "Run in-place upgrade for dev-db-01 to 8.4.9"
- "Check the status of my batch upgrade"
- "Resume the batch upgrade from where it left off"
